message: macro `exprM` has an expression template and cannot stand in declaration position
notes: an expression macro's template is one expression; a declaration position needs declarations (macro-system.md MAC-CAP-8)
help: give it a rule form - `(macro name ((name args ...) (fn ...) ...))` - whose template is declarations

message: a generated declaration's name must be a bare identifier; `nm` was given an expression
notes: the parameter stands in a NAME position of the template - a declaration head or a parameter list - and only an identifier can be a name
help: pass a plain name in this argument position

message: declaration macro `declM` invoked in expression position
notes: the two template kinds are disjoint: an expression position needs a value, and this macro generates declarations (macro-system.md MAC-CAP-8)
help: a rule-form macro's template is declarations; invoke it at top level
